findings.passage: He played key roles in the requirement to show photo-ID to vote and to allow Ohioans the constitutional right to carry .
findings.note: From the About section of his campaign site (written in the third person, undated). It describes his work on Ohio's photo-ID-to-vote requirement.

Listed as a cosponsor of Ohio House Bill 458 (134th General Assembly), as enrolled. The bill changes Ohio voter identification and absentee voting law. Its text asks a voter at the polls for a current and valid photo ID, a military ID, or a copy of a utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or other government document; a voter without one may cast a provisional ballot; a voter with a religious objection to being photographed may use an affidavit. Date shown is the governor's signing date (concurrence 2022-12-14, effective 2023-04-07); the date he signed on as cosponsor was not retrieved.
